taste.name: The index replaces the showcase
taste.trigger: When projects and essays needed to be browsed quickly
taste.decision: Chose linked names with one-sentence descriptions over project cards, screenshots or thumbnails
taste.reason: The visitor compares what was made and why it exists without first decoding presentation chrome

taste.name: Distance carries hierarchy
taste.trigger: When the page needed to separate biography, projects and writing
taste.decision: Chose repeated 128px chapter gaps over borders, background changes or oversized headings
taste.reason: A long blank interval makes the next topic unmistakable while leaving each list internally compact
evidence: Only one 116px measured section gap in rendered blocks

taste.name: Two weights do all semantic work
taste.trigger: When names, labels and descriptions required distinction
taste.decision: Chose one 16px family in weights 400 and 500 over a display face and multi-step heading scale
taste.reason: Visitors can scan the information as a personal record rather than as a campaign page
evidence: Sans is the only detected family
Weights 400 and 500 are the only detected weights

taste.name: Color stays out of the argument
taste.trigger: When links and projects could have received individual accent colors
taste.decision: Chose #21201C and #63635E text on #FDFDFC over a branded accent palette
taste.reason: The hierarchy comes from language, order and spacing, so no project gains importance merely through color
evidence: #FFFFFF accounts for 88.7% of measured background area
Only two text colors appear repeatedly
No colored accent candidate was detected
